items.q: Can I use the audio commercially?
items.a: Yes, audio made on paid plans can be used in videos, ads and courses.

items.q: Can I clone my own voice?
items.a: Voice cloning is not part of this demo. It is planned as a separate, consent based feature.

items.q: How long can a script be?
items.a: Demo samples are short clips. Longer scripts are part of the paid plans.

footer.privacyText: Voxa stores only the account details you provide and the audio you save. Demo samples stay in your browser and are never sent to a server. You can delete your account and audio at any time.
footer.termsText: Voxa is provided as is for voice generation. You own the audio you create from your scripts. Final pricing, limits and availability are confirmed on the pricing page before you pay.
